tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// /bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po la bstod pa bzhugs/

oṃ swā stī/ bde legs phan dang bde ba ni/ kun gyi 'byung gnas rgyal ba la/ /gang zhig cung zad dad byed pa/ /de la'ang phun tshogs thams cad 'byung*/ /rmongs rnams skal ba dman pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba la yang mos bral zhing*/ /dam pa'i chos las phyir phyogs pa/ /'di dag ba lang mngon sum bzhin/ /bzlas brjod smra ba ji snyed pas/ /yon tan lan cig brjod pa mchog /yang na mi smra'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /smra na 'di nyid smra bar shog khams gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag na/ khyod dang mnyam pa'ang ma mchis na/ /lhag pa'i dri yang ga la zhig /mnyam med mi mnyam mnyam la 'dud/ /dpe gzhan rnyed par ma gyur nas/ /rnam gzigs la sogs dper bgyid snyam/ /khyed dag de dag ye shes kyi/ /sku dbyer med pas dpe ma rnyed/ /'gro kun phan bder 'god pa'i byams pa dang*/ /sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las skyob thugs rje can/ /nye ring mi mnga' btang snyoms tshad med de/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la gnas khyod la 'dud/ /ji ltar bu gcig gdung ba'i ma bzhin du/ /nam yang brtse bas nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /sdug bsngal 'gro la g.yel ba med par gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po'i spyan ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /tshig dang don dang nges tshig ma lus la/ /'gro ba'i mgon po'i spobs pa zad mi shes/ /nyon mongs spyod ba'i sems can kun 'dul ba/ /mi mchog 'dul ba'i gtso la gus phyag 'tshal/ khyod ni rtag tu mnyam par 'jog mdzad kyang*/ /lhun grub chags thogs med pa'i ye shes kyis/ /sems can kun gyi the tshom gcod mdzad pa/ /smra ba'i seng ge khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ser skya grog mkhar rgyas pa me bzhi 'jug /sna tshogs bshes gnyen gshin rje me la sogs/ /log par smra ba'i dri ma kun bkrus pa/ /drang srong chen po de la gus pas 'dud/ /zhi ba 'phrog byed dbyig gi snying po sogs/ /byed por smra rnams shin tu rmongs pa'i gnas/ /stong nyid chos kyi rnga bo che brdung pa/

/lha yi lhar gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /srid gsum bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'bod mkhas pa/ /sngon med dam chos rin chen gter gyur pa'i/ /gau taṃ chos kyi rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'jig rten rtog byed pa/ /shes par smra rnams lta ba'i thibs por chud*/ /gang dag cir yang gang zag ma dmigs pas/ /bdag med seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sgrog la 'dud/ /chos rnams nam yang rang bzhin ma mchis kyang*/ /rgyu 'bras tshul la bslu ba med pa ni/ /mgon po khyod kyis mkhyen zhing gzigs nas bstan/ /dbu ma'i lam gyis 'gro ba sgrol la bstod/ /yod med dngos dang dngos med mtha' dbus sogs/ /phan tshun la ltos blo yis btags par zad/ /skye 'gag rang gzhan gnyis kar ma dmigs zhes/ /stong nyid tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis ston la 'dud/ /mi sbyin bha ra dh+wa dza 'od bsrungs sogs/ /byed po tha dad rtog ges rnam par brtags/ /rgyal khyod sems tsam byed por gzigs nas ston/ /phra zhing rtogs dka' mkhyen pa khyod la 'dud/ /thal ba pa sogs gdung ba rtsom la dga'/ /'jig rten rnams ni 'dod la rnam par 'chums/ /mtha' gnyis spangs pa dbu ma'i spyod pa yi/ /lam ston khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro dang 'ong ba rnam bral zhing/ /chad pa ma lags rtag ma lags/ /mchis dang ma mchis ma lags pa/ /skye med sku la phyag mtshal lo/ /ji lta ba dang ji snyed kun/ /dus gsum ye shes gcig kho nas/ /skad cig gcig la mkhyen mod kyang*/ /dmigs pa mi mnga' khyod la 'dud/ /tshad med 'og min zhing mchog tu/ /ston pa mthong na mi mthun med/ /sras mchog theg chen dbang bskur bas/ /chos kyi dga' ston rgyun mi 'chad/ /'on kyang ma lus zhing rnams su/ /gang la gang gis 'dul ba der/ /de de'i tshul du ston mdzad kyang*/ /lhun grub rnam par rtog mi mnga'/ /smon lam dbang gis 'gro ba ni/

/mos pa dbang po khams tha dad/ /ji bzhin ma 'khrul don mdzad pa/ /dmigs med thugs rje ngo mtshar rmad/ /rnam mi rtog la thugs rje che/ /ma rtags [ brtags ] gtang snyoms mi mnga' ba/ /'gal ba 'dra la mi 'gal te/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal/ khyod ni thugs rje'i dbang gyur pas/ /sna tshogs tshul dang spyod pa bstan/ /thogs med dus nas byang chub kyang*/ /da dung skye rabs dus mthar ston/ khyod sngon nyon mongs bcas tshe yang/ /rgyal srid btsun mo mdzes ma dang*/ /dbu dang sku yang grangs med stsal/ /de tshe mchod 'os khyod la 'dud/ /lha dang drang srong dbyangs can dang*/ /seng ge stag dang ri bong sogs/ /'byung ba bzhi sogs 'gro ba yi/ /nyer 'tsho kun tu sprul par mdzad/ /gzo yi las rnams sna tshogs dang*/ /rig sngags sna tshogs tshul yang ston/ /dge ba cung zad ji snyed pa/ /de kun mgon po khyod kyi mthu/ /'phrin las pha mtha' ma mchis pa/ /'di la su zhig dpyod par sems/ /shes rab med na sbyin sogs gang*/ /thar par 'jug par nus ma yin/ /bsod nams tshogs ni med gyur na/ /shes rab kyis kyang mya ngan 'da'/ /gang zhig tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs pas/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa brnyes/ /pha rol phyin drug yongs rdzogs pa/ /mgon po khyod 'dra gzhan ma mchis/ khyod kyi 'khor gyi tha chung yang*/ /'jig rten gsum gyi brgyan du gyur/ khyod kyis thabs mang yid byed dang*/ /dmigs pa'i khyad par kun bstan kyang*/ /'di na rnam par mi rtog dang*/ /so sor rtog la phan tshun smod/ khyod sngon byang chub dus mtha' ni/ /blo ldan sus kyang mi rtogs mod/ /grangs med gsum gyis tshogs rdzogs pa'i/ /tshul yang phyi nas yang yang bstan/ /lam dang sa las rab 'das kyang*/ /sa bcu sgrod pa'i tshul yang ston/ /me khyer bye ba khrag khrig gis/ /sa gzhi rir bcas gsal mi nus/ /nyin byed gcig gis kun gsal ltar/ /'phags dang byis pa'i bsod nams khyad/

/mtha' yas rgyu las sgrubs pa yi/ /sku yang yon tan dpag tu med/ /mtshan dang dpe byad re re yang*/ /bsod nams ye shes dpag med las/ /mngon par sgrubs na chos kyi sku'i/ /rgyu rnams mtha' yas lta ci smaus/ /dga' ldan gnas kyi gzhal med khang*/ /mdzes byed dam pa tog dkar gyur/ /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang*/ / gzhon nu rgyal tshab nges 'byung dang*/ /dka' ba spyod dang bdud btul dang*/ /byang chub tshangs pa'i 'khor lo bskor/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das ston sogs/ khyod kyi thabs mkhas 'ba' zhig lags/ /rgyu rkyen las dang rnam smin mos pa khams/ /dbang po lam dang bsam gtan sngon gyi gnas/ /phyi ma'i dus dang zag pa zad mkhyen pas/ /stobs bcus bdud bzhi 'joms par mdzad la 'dud/ /chos rnams kun la mkhyen pa'i snang ba rgyas/ /gegs rnams dang ni lam dang 'gog ston la/ /srid gsum 'di na rgol ba'i gnas ma mchis/ /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyod lam ma 'khrugs ca co mi mnga' zhing*/ /dran pa ma nyams rtag tu mnyam par bzhag /gdul bya'i don la ma brtags btang snyoms med/ /'dun dang brtson 'grus dran pa ting nge 'dzin/ /shes rab rnam grol ye shes nyams mi mnga'/ /chags thogs mi mnga' dus gsum cig car gzigs/ /sku gsum thugs kyi cho 'phrul 'phrin las la/ /ye shes sngon 'gro rjes su 'jug pa ste/ /ma rig sgrib 'joms rdo rje 'jigs bral bas/ /seng ge dang mtshungs mkha' ltar ma 'dres chos/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kyi rtogs dka' bas/ /'phags pa kun gyi'ang bla mar gus pas 'dud/ /zhing kun sgrod mdzad sems kyi spyod kun mkhyen/ /thams cad skad kyis 'chi 'pho sngon gyi gnas/ /gzigs nas nges 'byung mkhyen pas gzhan la 'doms/ /mngon par mkhyen nas don mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /spyan lnga ldan pas bag chags thams cad spangs/ /gtsang ma rtogs pa bde ba'i sku brnyes shing*/ /dam pa'i bdag nyid rin chen gter mtshungs pa/

khyod la rtag par snying nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa thog mtha' smra dang rgyu med dang*/ /byed po dus sogs snying po med gzigs nas/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rten 'brel las dang 'bras/ /sdug bsngal rnam grol rgyu bcas ston la 'dud/ khyod gsung rdo rjes 'j-igs tshogs lta ba'i ri/ /rtsa bcas bcom zhing 'khor bar rtag 'khyams rnams/ /yan lag brgyad ldan 'phags pa'i lam la 'khrid/ /chu bo las sgrol ded dpon mchog la 'dud/ /phyin ci log bzhi'i rgya mtshor bying pa rnams/ /mi gtsang mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa zhes/ /dran pa 'jog byed blo gros grur bcug nas/ /thar pa nor bu'i gling du sgrol la 'dud/ /snyoms 'jug dgu dang rnam thar zil gnon brgyad/ /zad par bcu thob zhugs 'bras mngon byas pa/ khyod rjes 'jug na blo brtul rnams kyang ste/ /zhing gi rdul snyed de rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba las gzhan rnam dag lam ston pa/ /dus rnams kun tu yod pa ma yin pas/ /skye ba kun tu ston pa gzhan spangs nas/ /skyob pa khyod la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /chu gter chen po skyal ba yis/ /ji lta bur na rgal bar byed/ /'dren pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho la/ /'di ltar 'jug pa'ang ga zha'i rgyu/ /rgyal ba'i bstod pa nam mkha' la/ /rgyal sras mkha' lding 'jug mod kyang*/ /bstod byed rang nyid chog shes kyi/ /bsngags 'os dag gi mtha' ma mthong*/ /bdag gis cung zad bstod byas pa'ang/ rmongs pas ma yin phyogs lhung min/ /bdag la dgos phyir ma yin te/ /yon tan ldan phyir dad pas bstod/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyod bstod mod/ / bsam pa blun po'ang gus bstod pas/ /dpag yas chos kyi rgyal por shog /bdag lus zhing rdul snyed sprul nas/ /rgyal ba re re'i spyan sngar gnas/ /re re'ang gdung dang lce de snyed/ /tshig gi brjod pa'ang de snyed kyis/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba yi/

/gsung la bdag kyang rab 'jug pas/ khyod la bstod cing bsngags bgyid la/ /de kun bdag gis thob par shog /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan dang*/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las dag /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can gyis/ /rgyun mi 'chad par thob gyur cig /ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba ste rang lo nyer lnga pa la'o/ /maṅga lam bi stār ku ru/ /'gro kun phan bde'i rtsa lag zla med pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gtsug lag khang chen 'dir/ /mgon po khyod nyid bskal par bzhugs nas kyang*/ /bdag sogs sems can rnams la thugs rjes gzigs// //oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhwā// par yig gnyis kyi 'du byed rdzong ri ba/ /byams pa rgyal mtshan bdag gis zab te bskos// maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po la bstod pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 2 -- PAGE 3 -- PAGE 1 -
